flashModeHint: Default aligns with the flash mode this release’s standard build already leverages per chip - the lowest-risk choice, and a hard requirement to stay aligned with an existing bootloader during an in-place update. DIO/QIO force that mode where a matching release build is available in the roadmap - reference the chart above for which chip(s) this currently applies to.
